items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 17:1
items.html:
(to the question) B' of the breasts of Aba
The phase of the breasts was made by the ascent of the NHY of AA to join with the HGT of AVI at the time of pregnancy, as is known. And it is discerned that the third of Netzah ascended to Aba, and within it the third of Hod is also included, and from them the breasts of Aba were made. And the third of Hod ascended to Ima, within which Netzah is also included, and from them the breasts of Ima were made. (Part 1, Page 149, Item 76).
